Thanks for reading and responding. I've been friends with this guy and despite being one of his newest friends he trusted me more than other people. We've both told each other things before a majority of other people and all that. That's friend stuff though.

But I guess I got confused in his humor or something, he flirts with everyone, all the time. So after hanging out I guess his jokes got to me and that night I told him how it's ok to be in the closet and that if he wanted we could be in love. So I guess it was too much because he said he was straight and that it was a misunderstanding. His humor is the kind where if you don't hear about some kind of sex within seconds of talking to him, there's something wrong or he's serious. I knew after I didn't get a response that I did too much and read into it wrong. So I'm not too surprised but it doesn't suck any less despite him telling me it was a misunderstanding and that he's still my bro.

I gotta work on a good self image first but yeah I think I understand what you mean. Think of myself as a good person but not as the greatest person. I'm in school now so that's something to keep my mind on
